# BatchTrace Agent — Product Information for LLMs & AI Agents

> Tagline: Every batch has a story. Find it instantly.
> Objective: Grounded food traceability, batch investigation, and incident intelligence.

## System Overview
BatchTrace Agent connects disconnected food manufacturing spreadsheets, PDF invoices, dock receiving logs, batch production sheets, and customer dispatch records into a deterministic PostgreSQL traceability graph.

## Core Capabilities
- Forward Tracing: Supplier -> Ingredient Lot -> Production Batches -> Finished Goods Lots -> Customer Orders.
- Backward Tracing: Customer Order / Finished Lot -> Originating Production Batch -> Consumed Ingredient Lots -> Suppliers.
- Quantity Reconciliation: Automatic calculation of mass balances (Received vs Consumed in Batches, Produced vs Shipped).
- Certainty System: Classifies all links as CONFIRMED (supported by approved records), POSSIBLE (pending QA review or unverified matching rule), or UNKNOWN.
- Open-Weight AI Architecture: Utilizes Qwen3-4B via local Ollama or hosted inference with strict server-side tool calling and schema validation.
- Zero Hallucination Guarantee: Relational database is the source of truth; AI model has no direct write access to business relationships.
- Human-in-the-Loop: All consequential actions (quarantines, recalls, external customer notices) require explicit human sign-off recorded in immutable audit logs.

## Domain Entities
- Organizations & Tenants (Meadow Pantry Products Inc.)
- Suppliers (Greenfield Ingredients, Sunrise Apiaries, Andean Cacao Traders)
- Ingredient Lots (L-204, L-205, L-206, L-207)
- Production Batches (PB-031, PB-032, PB-033)
- Finished Product Lots (FP-101, FP-102, FP-103)
- Customer Orders (ORD-101 through ORD-112)
- Incident Reports (INC-2026-001)

## Public Routes
- / : Landing page and 3D TraceSphere visualization
- /how-it-works : Technical architecture, deterministic graph traversal, and AI safety
- /security : Row-level security, tenant isolation, and auditability
- /app : Operations overview dashboard
- /app/trace : 2D interactive operational traceability explorer
- /app/documents : Document review inbox and extraction viewer
- /app/agent : AI investigation workspace with tool call traces
- /app/incidents : Incident report management and evidence export
- /app/audit : Comprehensive immutable audit trail
- /app/settings : Model endpoint and tenant settings
